requirement:
HC represents a GitHub issue by a stable owner, repository, and issue-number
identity. Reading the node supplies the issue's title, opening post, and
open/closed status as one snapshot. HC computes its fingerprint and formatted
text from that supplied snapshot through `Domain`.

For illustration:

```rust,ignore
struct GithubIssueContents {
    title: String,
    opening_post: String,
    status: IssueStatus,
}

enum IssueStatus {
    Open,
    Closed,
}
```
rationale:
`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes` requires three things. HC must identify a GitHub issue by a stable owner, repository and issue number. Reading the node must supply the title, opening post and open/closed status as one snapshot. HC must compute the fingerprint and formatted text from that snapshot through `Domain`.

The `references` tool shows no {test} or {impl} sites for this requirement, so none of these obligations has a test. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` carries a {fixme} for exactly this requirement. Its body says that stable owner/repository/number identity and retained title/opening-post/status contents have no implementation or tests. It names `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26`, which is open. The only GitHub-related code I found is the offline `GithubIssues` handle in `HabeasDomain`'s `outgoing_edges`. I did not read it closely, but it does not suggest the gap has closed.

The missing tests are therefore a real gap, and the open {fixme} acknowledges it.
